title: CerebralHelm Spotify Create Playlist Input
description: Property names are prefixed because the code generator derives type names from property names: a bare `name`/`description` would mint or steal a generic type across the whole shared module.

playlistName.description: The playlist's name, as it will appear in Spotify.

playlistDescription.description: Optional description, as shown in Spotify clients.

playlistIsPublic.description: Whether the playlist appears on the user's public profile. Absent means private: Spotify's own API defaults this to true, and silently publishing something to someone's profile is not a default worth inheriting.
